verdict.line: You lose only if he silences you with Q (Decisive Strike) into a full E (Judgment) trade before you have W (Riposte) up; you win the moment you can parry that Q on demand.

brief.thesis: This matchup is decided entirely by whether Fiora's W (Riposte) is available and correctly timed against Garen's Q (Decisive Strike) — parry the silence and he has zero disengage or lockdown tools left against your E (Blade Waltz) mobility, and the duel is yours. He has no dash, no gap closer, and no way to punish your kiting once his Q is down, so the whole lane is a rhythm of baiting his Q and then all-inning the cooldown.

theirWindow.when: his Q and E both off cooldown, flash up
theirWindow.what: He can silence your Riposte cast, then chain E (Judgment) and autos into a trade you can't parry out of. If you see him walking up with Q clearly available, don't extend — back off and force him to use it on a minion or waste it.

yourWindow.when: his Q (Decisive Strike) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: All-in immediately. Without Q he has no silence and no speed burst to stick to you, so land Riposte (W) on his next auto or E tick for the slow, then Blade Waltz (E) onto his vitals and burn Grand Challenge stacks with autos.

start.why: Extended trades against his E (Judgment) ticks need the sustain, and the AD keeps your riposte punish relevant early.

boots.why: Garen's entire early damage is physical autos plus E spin ticks — flat armor and the auto-attack reduction gut his trade damage specifically.

core.why: Spellblade proc plus move speed lets you land Riposte, dash in with E, and actually stick or disengage against a champion with no gap closer.
Armor shred and the slow stack keep your vitals damage from R going through even if he builds tanky, and stop him from walking away between E resets.
The HP and damage reduction buffer directly counters his R (Demacian Justice) true-damage execute threshold, buying you the extra survival window to finish the trade.

situational.when: he starts stacking armor or health and your all-ins are getting outlasted
you're ahead and want insurance against his ult or a jungle gank while split pushing
their team has a heavy AP threat that can burst you through Sterak's

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks fast through auto-riposte-dash sequences and gives the sustain you need to win extended trades before his R execute range matters.

summoners.why: Flash covers a missed Riposte window or resets an all-in engage; Teleport lets you play the wave-priority split-push game where Fiora's duel threat outclasses Garen's macro presence.

playing.title: Bait his Q before committing
playing.detail: Never throw Riposte reactively on cooldown — walk into range so he's tempted to Q you, then hold W until he actually casts it. If he whiffs it on a minion or doesn't take the bait, that's your all-in window.

playing.title: Save Riposte for the silence
playing.detail: Riposte parries his Q (Decisive Strike) silence outright, not just the follow-up auto. Timing it on the silence itself, not on his E tick, is what takes his entire lockdown package off the table.

playing.title: Track his passive regen timer
playing.detail: Garen's passive (Perseverance) ramps up hard after roughly 9 seconds out of combat. Don't disengage a trade early and let him heal it back — commit fully once you've landed the parry.

playing.title: Respect the execute threshold
playing.detail: His R (Demacian Justice) deals true damage scaling with your missing health. Post-level 6, don't sit below roughly 30% HP in his ult range even mid-trade, since it can flip a winning fight.

playing.title: Dash vitals, kite the spin
playing.detail: His E (Judgment) is a stationary hitbox centered on him — walk out of it between autos rather than trading inside it. Use E (Blade Waltz) to jump onto revealed vitals and reset position at the same time.

playing.title: Punish empty cooldown windows
playing.detail: The instant his Q is down, you have a free all-in with no silence or speed threat incoming — take it every time rather than waiting for a bigger window that may not come.

playing.title: Force macro with split push
playing.detail: Once Trinity Force is up, your 1v1 duel threat is high enough that Garen either has to commit top or lose the lane to a split, pulling him off map presence he'd otherwise use to help his team.

brief.patchCaveat: Item and rune names reflect the standard Fiora build as of my training data (Trinity Force into Black Cleaver, Conqueror keystone) — verify exact stats and pricing against patch 16.18.1 patch notes, since numbers and item names shift between patches.
